focus: correctness inherited-defect and metadata consistency of the phase parent

findingDetails.title: Obsolete /spec_kit: command prefix survives in the shipped phase-parent template and five reference docs, and no ledger row ever owned it
findingDetails.impact: A weak model scaffolding a phase parent is taught a command namespace that does not exist, in the exact file the packet's own spec.md was generated from.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Construct the three census rows (NEW-12, NEW-13, NEW-14) and repair the four template and reference locators, then regenerate or hand-fix spec.md:143.

findingDetails.title: Parent spec launch precondition names swe-2-max as the benchmark subject, contradicting its own Out of Scope section and frozen decision D8
findingDetails.impact: An operator reading only the launch preconditions measures the wrong executor, and that measurement is the packet's deciding evidence.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Rewrite precondition 4 to name cli-devin deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017-max as the subject, matching spec.md:92 and goal.md D8.

findingDetails.title: graph-metadata.json derived.status says in_progress while the parent reads Complete and last_active_child_id is still phase 004
findingDetails.impact: Derived metadata and the authored status disagree, so graph-driven tooling reports an in-progress packet that is closed.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Refresh graph-metadata.json after the closeout so derived.status and last_active_child_id match the phase map.

findingDetails.title: Parent Branch metadata reads main while every phase ran on the worktree branch
findingDetails.impact: The branch row cannot be used to recover where the work happened, and the template will repeat it.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Record worktrees/217-weak-model-spec-authoring, or drop the inherited row when the operator's workspace choice differs from main.

findingDetails.title: Two parent-spec pointers dangle: Parent Spec ../spec.md and the phase 003 decision record
findingDetails.impact: Readers following either pointer reach nothing, which is the copy-a-dead-pointer failure the packet exists to remove.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Point Parent Spec at the track root or drop it, and cite 003-versioned-placeholder-gate/plan.md ADR-003 instead of a nonexistent decision-record.md.

searchLedger.rationale: No waived or superseded row exists in the packet; folder-structure.md:140 makes decision-record.md optional. The dangling pointers that remain are recorded separately as R1-P2-003

searchLedger.rationale: Both files read Level 2 and the packet is a phase parent without plan.md or tasks.md
